definitions.full: H7711. shdephah שְׁדֵפָה noun feminine blighted or blasted thing ; — ׳וּשׁ קָמָה לִפְנֵי 2Kin 19:26 a blasted thing before (the standing grain , i.e. before maturity ( > שְׁדֵמָה field, as || Isa 37:27 , compare Di), but improbable; Th proposes ׳וּשׁ ׳ל וָדִים ; Kit הַקָּדִים שְׁדֻף ; We (and most since) וגו קֻמְךָ לְפָנַי ָ ׳וּשְׁדֵפָֽה (Che וּשְׁפָיִים , for וּשְׁדֵפָה ). שִׁדָּפוֺן noun masculine blight , of crops (Lag BN 202 Vogelst Landwirthsch. 56 ); — ׳שׁ absolute + יֵרָקוֺן Amos 4:9 , compare Hag 2:17 ; Deut 28:22 ; 1Kin 8:37 2Chr 6:28 .
